# The policy comparison preserves Thunderbird's custom-download folder-list difference

The comparison-test entry allows the source difference that requests browser.download.folderList=2 after setting the default download directory. The production callback is not changed by this entry. The test serializes policy method source and checks exact allowed lines, so this is source-comparison coverage rather than a download or preference-runtime assertion.

Scope: Enterprise policy callback and source comparison.
